title: The 'Hidden' Biological Impact of Vitamin D Deficiency: a Biomarker Study; Part 2
brief_summary: The investigators major aims are to: determine the vitamin D status of a group of young, apparently healthy adults in Hong Kong; examine inter-relationships between vitamin D status and biomarkers of DNA damage and repair, oxidative stress, inflammation and endothelial health; and, in part 2 of the study, investigate effects of improvement in vitamin D status on these biomarkers and other measures of well-being in those young adults shown to be deficient in vitamin D.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* apparently healthy, non-smokers
* non-obese
* found (in part1) to have low vitamin D status

Exclusion Criteria:

* chronic illness
* serious illness requiring medical treatment in previous 6 months
* pregnancy
* on regular medication or taking supplements on a regular basis
